run_split_data_cli: run the script to split a dataset file into train, valid, and test splits
run_power_law_sampling: run the power-law index sampling algorithm to distribute validation and test indices across data
run_three_way_split: run the three-way data split that outputs .train, .valid, and .test files from a single dataset
run_distribution_sanity_check: run the sanity check that prints a histogram of index distribution per decade
run_progress_reporting: run the script with progress reporting that prints status every million lines processed
